newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Nov 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Nov 13.

text.p: The following is a summary of major South Korean political stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not gaurantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- Political tensions high as government, opposition camps at odds over parliamentary ratification of South Korea's entry into OECD, other issues pending before parliamentary budget session.
- Government, ruling party agree to relax greenbelt regulations to pave way for new sports facility, theatre, library, hospital projects.
- 95 members of militant student organization arrested for inciting violent demonstrations in recent protest rallies.
- Federation of Korean Industries voiced strong objection to suggested labour law reforms such as multiple trade unions and intervention of third parties in labour disputes.
- Presidential commission for labour reforms fails to work out unified labour law revision, but submits compromise recommendations.
